name: Plains
description: Open rolling plains providing standard movement and unhindered combat.

name: Forest
description: Dense foliage reducing movement speed and mitigating 35% of incoming ranged damage.

name: Hills
description: High ground offering +2.0 attack range and +25% damage bonus against lower elevation targets.

name: Marsh
description: Waterlogged terrain causing severe movement penalties and disabling charge momentum.

name: Road
description: Paved military road granting 25% movement speed bonus.

name: Water
description: Impassable water body blocking all ground unit transit.

name: Rubble
description: Destroyed fortification rubble providing 20% cover with 25% movement penalty.
